measured_refusal: Full original-scope replay stops in the fourth cohort because a native source is included more than once; the initial reader deliberately refused repeated evaluation.
rules: Keep every native token and source evaluation in counts. Static source definitions use source-file identity, not include execution multiplicity.

A repeated source evaluation may share the same source definition set only when its entire native tree, every decoded argument, all token start/end lines, token count and file-end counter exactly equal the earlier evaluation. Record the full evaluation count and callback total.
Any difference between repeated native source trees refuses the entire family. Never select one occurrence, filter by scanner candidates or change the original input/ingest exclusions.

Require authored duplicate-include success and differing-repeat refusal controls before the next canonical query. This changes no product engine, metric denominator, subject pin, required kind or L3 reading.
